reason: Place the first specimen at the flight locker; it is the only gameplay action offered and addresses the remaining goal.

effect: The first membrane specimen is at the flight locker, completing the remaining goal alongside the cooled cores.
reaction: The placement was a straightforward finish, though less vivid than transferring the cores.

mostWorthwhile.text: Loading the remote core was most worthwhile: seeing the folded outline again connected the careful transfer to the discovery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the membrane at the locker was the least engaging moment; it was the only available action and had no descriptive payoff.

surprise.text: The chilled carrier had a transfer buffer and separate cradles for the complete liners, making the continuity of cooling clearer.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; each action had a clear purpose in preparing or securing the specimens.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what the receiving laboratories learn, although the straightforward packing steps themselves were not especially engaging.
